newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Air offers Visa card for frequent flyers.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Air offers Visa card for frequent flyers.

text.p: Southwest Airlines on Wednesday launched a Visa credit card for its frequent flyer reward program.
Company officials said the Rapid Rewards Visa Card, issued by First USA Bank, will allow members to earn flight credits towards free travel.

Under the frequent flyer program, members receive a free roundtrip ticket on Southwest for every 16 flight credits earned within a 12-month period. A one-way flight is worth one credit and a roundtrip journey gives members two credits.
With the new Visa card, members will earn one flight credit for each $1,000 in purchases, up to a maximum of $75,000 in purchases annually.
Southwest Air said the Visa card carries an introductory interest rate of 6.9 percent for the first six months and that there will be no annual fee for the first year.
